sec-oncall-bot: ALERT: RBAC anomaly detected in prod · unexpected role-binding created for serviceAccount:svc-dataflow@redwood-prod. Auto-score: 0.82
jun (oncall): Copy. I'm taking command.
jun (oncall): TL;DR — possible privilege escalation: new binding gives roles/editor to svc-dataflow in project redwood-prod. Need containment, evidence collection, and handoff.
alex (sec): Any terraform applies in last hour?
sara (infra): Not from infra team. No deploys scheduled.
mike (kms): Checking KMS logs now for any decrypts by that SA.
jun (oncall): Containment plan (quick):
1) revoke the binding
2) rotate service-account keys used for pipelines
3) snapshot audit logs and export to secure bucket
4) check KMS key access and rotate if necessary
5) notify SOC and legal if data exfil likely

jun (oncall): Doing step 1 now. Alex, can you confirm suppression/notifications for any runbooks?
alex (sec): Go ahead. Also capture the policy change event from Cloud Audit Logs before revocation. We need the exact actor.
sara (infra): I pulled the audit event:
```
resource.type="project"
protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail!="terraform@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
protoPayload.request.serviceAccountEmail="svc-dataflow@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

jun (oncall): revocation command ran:
```
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='serviceAccount:svc-dataflow@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/editor'
```
ops-bot: Role binding removal successful (run by jun). Reaction :white_check_mark:.
jun (oncall): Step 2: rotate keys. Sara, can you list active keys for that SA and rotate any user-managed keys?
sara (infra): Listing keys now. Found 1 user-managed key created 2025-08-01.
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-dataflow@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sara (infra): Rotating key, creating replacement, disabling old key. Will upload new credentials to workflows with limited access.
mike (kms): KMS lookup: no Decrypt operations by svc-dataflow in last 72h on primary keys. There are two recent Decrypts by service X at 03:12UTC but not by this SA.
alex (sec): Good. That reduces immediate data exfil risk but still treat as incident.
jun (oncall): Evidence collection: export audit logs for last 48h (IAM, AdminActivity, DataAccess) to gs://redwood-sec-evidence/tmp-1820309876. Sara, start export and lock bucket with retention.
sara (infra): Export started. Lifecycle: 90d retention, bucket locked to sec-admins only.

jun (oncall): Also: collect last-run terraform state snapshot and deploy logs for the ci user. Alex, can you check who issued SetIamPolicy?
alex (sec): From audit payload actor: svc-deployer@partner-externals.com — looks like a federated service account from partner CI. Not from our system accounts.

mike (kms): Cross-checked KMS access: partner CI service account DOES have limited key access for encrypt/decrypt on a different key (ingest-key). Not the main data KMS.

jun (oncall): Action items (immediate):
- [x] revoke binding (jun)
- [x] rotate user-managed key (sara)
- [x] export audit logs (sara)
- [ ] SOC notification (alex)

alex (sec): I'll open SOC ticket and escalate to Legal. Adding initial summary and attaching audit export link.

ops-bot: Deployment pipeline ingest-pipeline detected failing auth check and auto-paused (rule: pipeline-credential-sanity).
sara (infra): Paused jobs: ingest-pipeline-1, ingest-pipeline-2. I'm keeping them offline until keys rotated.

jun (oncall): Triage notes: actor appears to be federated external CI — need to review partner onboarding permissions and tighten federation constraints. No evidence yet of data exfil (no KMS decrypts by compromised SA).

alex (sec): Agree. Next steps: 24h deep audit, rotate any keys that partner CI can access, revoke federation trust if misconfigured, and schedule post-incident review (PIR).

jun (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing command to alex for follow-up and SOC coordination. alex, you'll be primary for the next 12h. I'll be available for escalation.
alex (sec): Ack. Taking command. I'll maintain the incident thread and post SOC ticket ID.

jun (oncall): Quick post-incident followups to add to PIR: tighten terraform provider principals, add guardrails for federated accounts, log-collection retention to 90 days for IAM admin events, add alert for any role-binding to high-priv roles.

alex (sec): Noted. I'll create the PIR doc and assign owners. Also adding temporary alert to block external SA role changes except via approved pipeline.

sara (infra): Final infra note: all rotated keys in secrets manager, paused pipelines restarted with new creds, no further anomalies for 30m.

alex (sec): SOC ticket #SOC-2026-1847 opened. Attaching evidence link: gs://redwood-sec-evidence/tmp-1820309876/audit-export.json

jun (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff complete. If anything else shows up, re-open channel or ping #incidents. End of shift. :v:"
